_about: Curated corrections and additions to the people/places/events graph (Theographic Bible Metadata) and to TIPNR name relationships. The build (scripts/import_theographic.py, scripts/build_database.py) applies them, and scripts/repair_theographic_graph.py brings an existing database into line. Each correction names the source value it replaces ('from'); if the source changes, the build stops so the correction can be reviewed. Event years are astronomical (-585 is 586 BC); people's years count BC directly (-1758 is 1758 BC).

event_predecessors.reason: Jesus was circumcised on the eighth day (Luke 2:21), not after Herod's massacre of boys up to two years old (Matt 2:16).
The presentation came at the end of the forty days of purification (Luke 2:22; Lev 12:2-4), before the flight to Egypt.
The magi came later than the birth, after the presentation (Matt 2:1, 11, 16: 'a house', boys 'two years old and under').
The family returned from Egypt after Herod died (Matt 2:19-21), so after the massacre, not after the circumcision.
The family settled in Nazareth on returning from Egypt (Matt 2:19-23; Luke 2:39).
